unrealtrainmod.configuration.translucent: Default Performance groups static batches by material, avoiding per-frame sorting and dynamic uploads, but overlapping translucent surfaces may blend incorrectly. Sorted draws triangles from far to near, adding CPU work and native index or Iris vertex uploads; it does not guarantee global ordering across vehicles. Applies to native and Iris vehicles and previews on the next relevant draw without a resource reload. Light overlays remain separate.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.maxPackageT: Maximum longest edge for vehicle, rail and wiring base textures, from 0 to 16384; default 2048. Zero keeps original sizes. Preserves aspect ratio without enlarging images; nearest sampling retains alpha thresholds and packed values. Atlas pages also respect the limit. Requires F3+T or a restart. Very small limits can remove fine details.
Default Low. Off uses Iris default normal/specular channels without package PBR decoding; Low limits the final auxiliary texture to a 1024-pixel longest edge; Full adds no reduction after base-size alignment. Packed channels use nearest sampling. Applies to vehicles and rails with shaders enabled. Requires F3+T or a restart.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.baseTexture: Soft GPU budget from 64 to 4096 MiB, default 512. Package base textures and Iris alpha variants upload on first use. CPU pixels stay loaded for alpha masks and re-upload. Excludes vanilla textures, GUI icons and PBR. Active and recently used textures may exceed the budget. Changes apply without a reload.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.nativeGeome: Soft GPU budget from 64 to 4096 MiB, default 512. Vehicle geometry uploads on first native world or preview submission. Idle GPU buffers can be evicted while CPU models remain loaded. Excludes Iris geometry, world tracks, instance buffers and dynamic sorted indices. Active and recent models may exceed the budget. Changes apply without a reload.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.pbrTextureC: Separate soft GPU budget from 16 to 4096 MiB, default 256, for shared package normal/specular channels. Channels decode and upload on demand. Eviction invalidates Iris holders and cancels pending loads; next use restores the channels asynchronously. Active and recent materials may exceed the budget. Changes apply without a reload.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.gpuCacheRet: Minimum idle time before over-budget base textures, native vehicle geometry or PBR can be evicted, from 0 to 60 seconds, default 10. Current and previous frame resources are always protected. Eviction runs after drawing; under-budget resources are retained. Changes apply without a reload. Iris geometry has its own retention setting.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.irisGeometr: Soft geometry budget from 64 to 4096 MiB, default 1024. Allocated on demand for Iris vehicles, static transparency, items and track parts. Larger budgets reduce uploads when turning between models. Active and recently viewed geometry may exceed the budget. PBR textures and the separate light cache are excluded. Menus only register ranges; GPU buffers upload on first use. Takes effect without reloading models.

Minimum idle time before over-budget geometry can be evicted, from 0 to 60 seconds, default 10. Keeps recently viewed models cached while turning the camera. Current and previous frame geometry is always protected. Entries remain cached while under budget. Takes effect without reloading models; the separate light cache is unchanged.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.logVehicleI: Disabled by default. Reports five-second windows per world or preview queue: draws, instances, submitted triangles, model counts, and CPU means and stage maxima for pose, scripts, queueing, opaque and translucent rendering. CPU scopes overlap and must not be added. Separately samples asynchronous GPU timeline spans for opaque and translucent passes, excluding intervening game rendering; these are not full-frame GPU times. Also reports native range-merge timings for pose IDs, signatures, bucketing, sorting, merging and cleanup, workspace growth, and IR batch layout during model loading. Disabling stops statistics and releases queries at the next vehicle queue frame.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.turnoutAnim: Client display only. Full-stroke duration from 0 to 10 seconds, default 1. Zero switches immediately. Nonzero changes apply to the next throw. Reversing continues from the displayed position at the full-stroke speed. Pausing stops animation. Routes, occupancy and interlocking still switch immediately.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.logItemRend: Disabled by default. Every five seconds, reports GUI, hand and world screenshot hits, native/Iris GPU draws, triangles, standard fallbacks and CPU submission costs. Also splits paths and fallback reasons by display context and main/shadow view. Separately counts icon generation and its readback/upload CPU cost. These are not GPU or full-frame times. Resource-pack replacements using ordinary models or dynamic model overrides bypass these counters.
unrealtrainmod.configuration.logTrackRen: Disabled by default. Reports main/shadow track draws, geometry, light, CPU timings and animations every five seconds. Includes fixed bufferMode=sharedPages, window duration, input/merged ranges, multi-draw, actual saved calls, shared-page residency and separate UV2 uploads. Separately reports total-station model native/Iris/fallback parts, draws, triangles, native uploads, CPU time and fallback reasons, excluding preview lines and text. Nonblocking GPU sampling every 16 frames excludes builds, budgeted uploads and empty frames. Separates stationary and animated spans; motion streaming remains included. These are not full-frame GPU times; missing samples show n/a.
